Convert a proxy record to the time domain using anchor points

Source: R/anchor2time.R
anchor2time.Rd

Convert a proxy record to the time domain using anchor points made using the astro_anchor function.

Usage

anchor2time(
  anchor_points = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  genplot = FALSE,
  keep_editable = FALSE
)

Arguments

anchor_points

Anchor points: the output of astro_anchor, or a matrix or data frame with depth in column 1 and time in column 2 (at least two rows, sorted by increasing depth). Time is linearly interpolated between the anchor points; above the first and below the last anchor point it is extrapolated with the sedimentation rate of the first/last anchored interval. Required (Default=NULL gives an error).

data

Proxy record to convert from the depth to the time domain: a two-column matrix or data frame with depth in column 1 (same unit as column 1 of anchor_points, sorted by increasing depth) and the proxy value in column 2. Required (Default=NULL gives an error).

genplot

Plot the result (logical, TRUE or FALSE). If TRUE, 3 plots are stacked on top of each other: 1) the original record in the depth domain, 2) the depth-time plot of the (extended) anchor points, 3) the record in the time domain. Default=FALSE.

keep_editable

Keep the plot layout and graphical parameters after plotting so that extra features can be added to the plot (logical, TRUE or FALSE); if FALSE the previous par() settings are restored. Only used when genplot=TRUE. Default=FALSE.

Value

The output is a matrix with 2 columns. The first column is time. The second column sedimentation proxy value.

If genplot=TRUE then 3 plots stacked on top of each other will be plotted. Plot 1: the original data set. Plot 2: the depth time plot. Plot 3: the data set in the time domain.

Examples

# Use the age_model_zeeden example anchor points of Zeeden et al., (2013)
#to anchor the grey data set of Zeeden et al., (2013) in the time domain.

grey_time <- anchor2time(anchor_points=age_model_zeeden,
data=grey,
genplot=FALSE,
keep_editable=FALSE)
